dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Don't miss out on Inazuma's creative cuisine!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Creative cuisine?

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Heh heh, that's right! You see, this street is filled with old, famous shops that serve people the same old stuff all the time!

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: So I thought that something creative and new might attract a real crowd!

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Aside from ordinary takoyaki and sushi, I've also added creative cuisines into the menu.

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: These are my pride and joy: Milky Natto Ramen, Colorful Spicy Dango... What do you think? Sounds delicious, no?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: If you ever get bored of ordinary food, be sure to come check out the new stuff here! See ya!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business doing?

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Erm... I am new to cooking, after all. It'd be best if I took things one step at a time...

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Though my dishes may sound a little strange, everyone who's tried it has said that they taste pretty good.

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Sir Kamisato of the Yashiro Commission visited my shop last time and took a liking to our milk tea!

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: However, perhaps the mix of foods is a little too strange, because we rarely get any returning guests. I suppose people are still too used to ordinary cuisine...

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Seems like I need to put more work into how I promote all this creativity...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the Dango Milk doing?

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Thanks to our Almighty Shogun, the number of people who came to buy some Dango Milk went up significantly. They all think it's pretty good, too.

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: I've given it a little thought, and given the kind of business we've been doing recently, there'd be no problem switching to just selling Dango Milk. Still, I love experimenting more...

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: I originally wanted to replace Dango Milk with some new creative dish, but my customers all missed its flavor. So after discussing it with them, I decided to return Dango Milk to the menu every so often.

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: As it turns out, it sold even better that way! Sometimes I couldn't even keep up with the demand, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One Dango Milk, please!

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: One Dango Milk, coming right up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Eh... Failure is but a part of innovation...

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Playing cards is like cooking. If you're creative enough, you'll win for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of creative cuisine is that?

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Dango Milk that's been marinated in rock, and macerated in roll — Rock 'n' Roll Dango Milk! Here, have one on me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's just regular Dango Milk, right?

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: I wouldn't go that far! At least, it might have been to begin with, but not after hearing all that rock 'n' roll that I made it listen to.

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: That's also why it now tastes like regular Dango Milk that's been lying around for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: But this way, some customers are even willing to pay double the price of regular Dango Milk just to get their hands on this stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Tomoki
dialogues.text: Must be the power of rock 'n' roll, eh? It's so mind-blowing that I can't even put it into words.
